notes: Lokalex Native Compose v3.0.3 (Build 303): Hotfix resolving startup and user login crash. Fixed unconstrained vertical measurement in ChatThreadListPane, offloaded user interaction sync to Dispatchers.IO to prevent ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException, added deterministic tie-breaking and safety fallbacks to sortAvailableRiders, and initialized global AppErrorTracker in LokalexApp.onCreate().

releases.headline: Hotfix: Startup & Login Crash Resolution, Layout Constraint & Gestures Hardening
releases.notes: Hotfix resolving startup and user login crash. Fixed unconstrained vertical measurement in ChatThreadListPane, offloaded user interaction sync to Dispatchers.IO, added deterministic tie-breaking to sortAvailableRiders.

releases.headline: Zero-Data Fast Reconnection, Lineup Fallback Hardening & Inbox Multi-Select
releases.notes: Zero-data fast user interaction reconnector with ETag 304 cache, zombie socket auto-healing, parallelized roster and login queries, and inbox long-press multi-select.

releases.headline: Admin Void Login, Ghost Status Protection & Team Leader Commission Inclusion
releases.notes: Admin Void / Cancel Login option in Logins modal to permanently delete accidental shift records and reset status to End.
